library.title: Documents
library.subtitle: Every module stores its files here. What a file is and who may open it follows the record it belongs to.
library.byRecordHint: The document service has no company-wide list: a file is reached through the record it belongs to, whose permission and data scope decide who may see it. Pick the kind of record and paste its id.
library.pickRecord: Pick a kind of record and paste its id to see its files.

types.title: Document types
types.subtitle: Registered when the modules are deployed, not editable here. The type decides the default confidentiality, how long a file is kept and which permission opens it.
types.search: Search code, name or record kind
types.tenantDefaultHint: The media types allowed for the whole company, from the document settings.

panel.uploaded: File uploaded. It can be opened once the virus scan comes back clean.
panel.noTypes: No document type belongs to this kind of record.
panel.notReady: The file cannot be opened yet: the virus scan is still running or it failed.

templates.title: Document templates
templates.subtitle: The files generated documents are built from. Upload a version, preview it with sample data, then publish it from a date.
templates.createHint: Pick what the template is for. A template for one legal entity wins over the company-wide one.
templates.noDefinitions: No module registers a document template yet.
templates.allTaken: Every registered template already exists for this scope.
templates.empty: No template has been set up yet. Documents cannot be generated until one is published.
templates.created: Template created. Upload a version to make it usable.
templates.sequenceHint: Only for a template that prints the doc.number placeholder. Leave it empty when the module numbers the document itself, as People does for contracts.

versions.title: Versions
versions.uploadHint: A .html file renders to PDF/A with Vietnamese fonts. A .docx file is merged with poi-tl and can only be delivered as .docx for now.
versions.uploaded: Version uploaded as a draft. Preview it, then publish it.
versions.publishHint: Documents generated from the start date use this version; the version published before it ends the day before.
versions.unknownFields: These placeholders are not merge fields of this template:
versions.validFromHint: Defaults to today. It must be later than the version published before it.
versions.previewOpened: The preview opened in a new tab.
versions.previewBlocked: The browser blocked the preview tab; it was downloaded instead.
versions.none: No version has been uploaded yet.

fields.title: Placeholders you can use
fields.hint: Copy a placeholder and paste it into the template file. In HTML a picture goes in the src of an img tag. Placeholders that are not on this list are refused on upload - including any written inside an HTML comment.

errors.unknown-template-definition: No module registers this template any more.
errors.template-exists: A template with this code already exists for this scope.
errors.unknown-sequence: That number series does not exist.
errors.invalid-template-file: A template must be a .docx or .html file.
errors.invalid-output-format: An HTML template renders to PDF; a DOCX template produces DOCX or PDF.
errors.unknown-merge-fields: The file uses placeholders that are not merge fields of this template.
errors.template-version-not-draft: Only a draft can be published.
errors.template-version-superseded: A version is already published from the same or a later date; publish from a later date.
errors.no-published-template: No version of this template is published for that date.
errors.no-template: This company has no template with that code.
errors.template-not-numbered: The template prints a document number but the template has no number series.
errors.pdf-converter-unavailable: Converting a DOCX template to PDF needs the document converter, which is not running. Publish a version with DOCX output.
